remarks: Nothing says 'Home Sweet Home' quite like a house with a white picket fence! Welcome to this charming 3-bedroom, 2-bath single-story home offering a spacious and versatile floor plan. Step inside to an extra-large separate living room, providing plenty of space for entertaining and family gatherings. The home features a combination of tile and wood flooring throughout. The kitchen offers upgraded appliances, plenty of workspace, and a convenient dine-in area, while the family room features a cozy fireplace perfect for relaxing at the end of the day. Step outside to a spacious backyard with mature fruit trees and plenty of room to relax, entertain, garden, or create your own outdoor retreat.
